CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content was found.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions) is identified and the same referent has an origin/ status field separating organization/presentation (origin) and a status flag (executed_branch_claim).

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to the identified content's presentation or access was stated.

C.rationale: The report explicitly names content entries with color attributes and coordinate sets.

D.rationale: A status field (executed_branch_claim:false) is separately attributed to the same content referent, distinguishing identification from status.

O.rationale: The report provides an origin/representation field for the referent indicating how the content is organized/presented (native_conditional_record, represented_time).
